title: Approval Request
description: A pending approval interaction for a tool call. Approval is optional by product and policy; when present, the request is emitted before the covered tool executes.

request_id.description: Stable identifier for this approval interaction.

tool_call_id.description: Identifier of the blocked tool call, when one exists.

actor_id.description: Actor whose attempted action needs approval.

summary.description: Safe human-readable summary; raw arguments and secrets do not belong here.

expires_at.description: Deadline after which the request is no longer actionable.
